messages:
Devon Liu: Heads-up — planning to convert svc-api from Deployment -> StatefulSet to get stable network identities. Quick check on termination ordering and initContainer behavior? Also terraform change will touch PVC templates. Pinging @Aj for TF plan review.

Aj Patel: Generally STS preserves ordinals; termination is highest -> lowest. initContainers run before app containers on each pod start. Are you using volumeClaimTemplates or pre-created PVCs?

Devon Liu: Using volumeClaimTemplates so PVC names will be generated by the STS. Concern: when we switch service selector labels we might route traffic to new ordinals mid-rollout. Thinking canary ~1 pod (10%) for 1h then rest.

Maria Chen: For that plan I'd use a partitioned rolling update. Set updateStrategy.type=RollingUpdate and set rollingUpdate.partition to currentReplicas - canaryCount. STS doesn't have maxSurge, so control with partition and podManagementPolicy. Also set podDisruptionBudget to allow only X unavailable.

Kyle R: Note: podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady guarantees ordinal ordering on start/terminate which is good for leader-type nodes. Parallel will start all at once. For graceful termination, ensure preStop hook is idempotent and connection draining is handled upstream.

Devon Liu: Good call. Example tf diff for pvc template in our module — can someone eyeball? 
```
module "svc_api" {
  source = "../modules/k8s_statefulset"
  replicas = 10
  volume_claim_templates = [
    { name = "data", storage_class = "fast-ssd", size = "50Gi" }
  ]
}
```
Will this cause PVC replacement/rename?

Aj Patel: volumeClaimTemplates create PVCs named <sts-name>-<claim>-<ordinal>. If you change the template name you'll get new PVCs. Changing storage_class or size may trigger a replace depending on SC allowVolumeExpansion. If TF wants to replace the k8s_stateful_set resource it'll recreate pods; check the plan. I'll add lifecycle.ignore_changes for fields that shouldn't force changes.

infra-bot: terraform plan for infra-svc-api: 1 to be replaced: kubernetes_secret.svc_api_creds (forces replacement) — plan shows no statefulset resource replacement.

Devon Liu: Wait secret replacement will cause pod restarts? The secret is mounted as envFrom.

Aj Patel: If pods reference secret via env, changing secret name or replacing resource will not auto-reload pods; but if secret resource is replaced (same name) K8s updates the secret and pods will see new env only on restart. For projected volumes or CSI provider there are ways to refresh without restart. For now we'll avoid replacing secret resource; I'll adjust TF and push patch.

Maria Chen: Also add readinessProbe delay increase during canary to reduce flapping. Set initialDelaySeconds to 60 for canary window.

Devon Liu: Thanks all — @Aj please ping when you've pushed the TF patch and I'll kick the canary. :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: Will do, pushing in 10m. :rocket:
